## What runs where

| Rule | Blocked when an edit is made | Blocked at commit |
|---|---|---|
| Generated views and `ledger/` are written only by the tools | Denied, including shell writes to them | Yes |
| JSON files keep their layouts | Denied | Yes |
| A claim's status changes only with human approval | **You get a prompt to approve** | No |
| An assessed phenomenon's wording is frozen | Denied | Yes, against the last commit |
| A verdict change needs a new derivation and a new note | Denied | Yes, against the last commit |
| `blind: true` only from an agent that hasn't read `spine.md`, GM or `claims.json` | Denied (I track who has read those files) | No |
| No downloaded papers, nothing over 2 MB | No | Yes |

`program/AGENTS.md` now opens with this table and points at each mechanism. I deleted the prose versions of these rules. Three rules still need judgment, so they stay as text in the research-loop skill: don't change `expect` just to make a check pass, "not provable" never counts as a refutation, and every new check kind needs a sanity check.

## How it persists

- **Claude Code hooks.** They're registered in the committed `.claude/settings.json`, so every session loads them.
- **The git hook.** A cloud session clones the repo fresh and loses the local git setting that turns on `.githooks/pre-commit`. The session-start hook sets it again on every start.

## The wrap-up hook

On `/clear`, `handoff.py` writes `.claude/handoffs/<time>-<session>.md`. It contains your prompts from the session, the commits made, anything left uncommitted, the gate's result, the task queue, and my last report. It's built from the transcript and git with no model involved, so it can't invent anything. It commits only that file, and pushes only on a `claude/*` branch that already tracks a remote. On the next start, or right after a clear, the newest handoff is loaded into context.

Two consequences you should know about:
- **Your prompts get committed.** The handoff copies them verbatim into the repo.
- **It pushes without asking.** On `claude/*` branches the handoff is pushed automatically. Say so if you'd rather it only commit locally.
